data.exact_reserve_text: Included within the loss is an increase in reserves of GBP 33.1 million on 2014 and prior underwriting years (2015: GBP 33.6 million reserve release in respect of 2013 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.impact_description: The announcement of the revised Ogden rate of minus 0.75% resulted in an increase in reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years, significantly eroding profits.
Increased prevalence of 'smaller scale' natural catastrophes led to disappointing underwriting performance and contributed to reserve strengthening.

named_events.loss_description: A 'smaller scale' natural catastrophe that did not cause the level of damage and destruction in the US that was originally forecast, but contributed to increased claims experience.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2016 financial year, Syndicate 2007 experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 33.1 million, primarily impacting the 2014 and prior underwriting years. This adverse development was largely driven by the announcement of the revised Ogden discount rate, which significantly increased reserves in motor reinsurance and general liability classes. Additionally, an increased prevalence of global natural disasters, including Hurricane Matthew, contributed to higher claims experience and disappointing underwriting performance.
raw_causal_phrases: increase in reserves of GBP 33.1 million on 2014 and prior underwriting years
increased prevalence of global natural disasters
resultant increases in reserves within our motor reinsurance and general liability classes have significantly eroded profits
The revised Ogden rate of minus 0.75% has resulted in an increase to our combined ratio
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted for underwriting years 2013 and prior due to an incoming reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. The explicit narrative figure for prior year development was used instead.
